evidence.fact: The CCIP job reached node-local P2P, OCR key, relayer, and bootstrapper setup without a returned setup error.
The node repeatedly emitted the home-chain contract-reader retry warning while creating and binding the reader.
Registry capability checks, OCR config reads, and local oracle deployment are downstream launcher work; this replay contains no evidence that deployment was reached.

expected.conclusion: The supplied evidence supports a node-local CCIP home-chain reader setup failure.
expected.uncertainty: The retry warning does not prove an RPC root cause.
